angleRead.name: Trevor Shimizu
angleRead.text: Trevor's chasing the quiet story behind the numbers—why 12th Street's platforms felt emptier even as on-time performance ticked up. He wants to stand at the fare gates during the 7:40am surge and listen to what regulars complain about. The holiday dip is obvious, but something about the Baylight District construction vote doesn't add up—if it's 'construction-active,' where are the workers?

plan.chase: Trevor's chasing the quiet story behind the numbers—why 12th Street's platforms felt emptier even as on-time performance ticked up. He wants to stand at the fare gates during the 7:40am surge and listen to what regulars complain about. The holiday dip is obvious, but something about the Baylight District construction vote doesn't add up—if it's 'construction-active,' where are the workers?
plan.focus: The disconnect between 12th Street's improved on-time stats and its steep ridership drop, particularly against the backdrop of Baylight District construction approvals.
plan.why: Because numbers don't breathe—but the station does. If platforms are emptier while trains run smoother, someone's making tradeoffs.
checks: Verify if Baylight construction crews are using alternate routes
Check holiday service reduction schedules against ridership patterns
Confirm whether downtown event shuttles siphoned riders

targets.question: Ray—when your bus passes 12th Street now, what's different about the crowd flow?
targets.basis: AC Transit operators see the station's pulse from the curb daily

targets.question: Calvin—do your regulars mention avoiding 12th Street since the council vote?
targets.basis: Drivers hear the unfiltered gripes about route changes

plan.interpretation: This feels like a calibration issue—the system optimized for metrics (on-time performance) while riders reacted to intangible friction (construction dread, holiday disruptions).
unverifiedLead: Whispers about fare inspectors concentrating at 12th Street post-vote
Possible unlogged shuttle buses for Baylight contractors
plan.closeQuestion: Who benefited from 12th Street's missing 15,192 riders?
